title: Canonical activation patterns and ReLU pattern varieties
abstract: arXiv:2611.20346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A ReLU pattern variety records the polynomial relations among the coefficients of the affine maps associated with a prescribed set of activation patterns of a ReLU network. We study how the combinatorics of the canonical set of activation patterns of an unbiased ReLU network is reflected in the geometry of its pattern variety. In particular, we introduce the notion of pattern stability and characterize pattern stability and combinatorial stability for shallow networks. When the associated wall graph is connected and contains an edge of every neuron label, we resolve a problem of Alexandr and Mont\'ufar by determining the defining ideal of the associated pattern variety explicitly. We establish a hierarchy of progressively weaker equivalence relations relating labeled combinatorial equivalence, equality and permutation equivalence of canonical pattern sets, and equivalences of the associated varieties. tldr: 本文引入模式稳定性概念并刻画浅层ReLU网络的模式稳定性与组合稳定性，在墙图连通的条件下显式确定了ReLU模式簇的定义理想（解决了Alexandr与Montúfar提出的问题），并建立了激活模式集合的各类等价关系与相应模式簇等价之间的层次结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of pattern stability, characterizes pattern and combinatorial stability for shallow ReLU networks, explicitly determines the defining ideal of ReLU pattern varieties when the associated wall graph is connected (resolving a problem of Alexandr and Montúfar), and establishes a hierarchy of equivalences relating canonical activation pattern sets and their associated varieties.
